supporting_refs.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting
supporting_refs.note: MDPI Jan 2026 — RNN+MC-Dropout Brier~0.206, 17th confirmation across fires

supporting_refs.title: Forecasting NCAA Basketball with LSTM and Transformer Models
supporting_refs.note: arXiv 2508.02725 — deep learning for basketball, NCAA but methods transfer

key_findings: IEEE paper provides systematic ML method comparison on NBA data — direct benchmark for our GA-evolved models
MDPI 2026 RNN+MC-Dropout achieves ~0.206 Brier — 17th independent confirmation of sub-0.22 barrier with deep learning
LSTM+Transformer (arXiv 2508) achieves state-of-the-art on sequential basketball data — temporal modeling gap in current GA fleet
Our fleet uses RF/ET/XGBoost/LightGBM but no sequential (RNN/LSTM) or uncertainty-quantified models

recommended_actions.action: Implement MC Dropout calibration wrapper for S15 RF-75f fleet-best (work-queue vm-mc-dropout-calibration-s15)
recommended_actions.expected_gain: Brier improvement ~0.001-0.003 from better probability calibration
recommended_actions.effort: LOW — wrapper around existing model, no retraining

recommended_actions.action: Replicate IEEE paper's feature set comparison — benchmark our 7246-col engine against their published feature categories
recommended_actions.expected_gain: Identify which feature categories the paper found most predictive vs our SHAP top features
recommended_actions.effort: MEDIUM — analysis task, no new training required

recommended_actions.action: Add LSTM island as S23 (TESTforge42) — sequential game-by-game prediction
recommended_actions.expected_gain: Potential path to Brier < 0.21, closing 0.014 gap to MDPI SOTA
recommended_actions.effort: HIGH — new space, new architecture; blocks on engine parity sync first
